description: This file defines types and functions related to JWT token handling, including date serialization, claim parsing, and JSON marshaling logic.

classes.name: NumericDate
classes.description: Represents a JSON numeric date value for JWT expiry and related fields.

classes.name: ClaimStrings
classes.description: A custom type for handling JWT claims that can be either a string or an array of strings, such as the 'aud' claim.

methods.name: NewNumericDate
methods.description: Constructs a NumericDate from a time.Time, truncating to the specified TimePrecision.

methods.name: newNumericDateFromSeconds
methods.description: Creates a NumericDate from a float64 representing UNIX epoch seconds, including fractional seconds.

methods.name: NumericDate.MarshalJSON
methods.description: Serializes NumericDate to JSON as a UNIX timestamp with specified precision.

methods.name: NumericDate.UnmarshalJSON
methods.description: Deserializes JSON into a NumericDate, handling both integer and fractional seconds.

methods.name: ClaimStrings.UnmarshalJSON
methods.description: Parses JSON data into ClaimStrings, supporting string, array of strings, or null.

methods.name: ClaimStrings.MarshalJSON
methods.description: Serializes ClaimStrings to JSON, either as a single string or an array, based on configuration.
